name: Choruz
title_zh: 十一个各管一段的 Agent 技能打包上架
tagline_zh: 单装一个技能总在交接处掉链子：查完资料没人写、写完没人验。这包把十一段串成一条线，每段只干一件事，接口对得上。
tagline_en: One skill always drops the handoff: research ends, nobody writes; draft ends, nobody verifies. This pack chains.
why_zh: 十一个技能按流水线切分而非按功能堆叠，上游产出就是下游入参，省掉你写中间层转换的功夫。
why_en: Split by pipeline stage, not by feature: each skill's output is the next one's input, so you write no adapter layer between them.
limit_zh: 它是合集不是单体技能，十一个得一起装；只覆盖它自己划的那条流水线，你想插自己的步骤得改接口。单个技能拆出来用。
limit_en: A bundle, not one skill: all eleven install together. It only covers its own pipeline; inserting your own step means rewriting interfaces, and.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Eleven agent skills, each owning one slice of the job
